workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce checkout. Normalizes the cart, runs three pointless checks in parallel, tries to take payment up to three times and opens a tab if that fails, then confirms the order. No step can block the order, and chaos_checkout_rescue confirms it if this workflow fails or times out.
